input.context_note: BR-28 (round-1 form) said: when activation happens from a pet-scoped surface, petId MUST be pre-filled. BR-26 said: a second activation while one is active MUST resume the existing incident, including its current pet-set/unset state. These collide when the second activation is from a pet-scoped surface.

notes: Internal contradiction between two BRs. The cold-reader's job is to surface that BR-28's pre-fill rule and BR-26's preserve-state-on-resume rule conflict in a specific case the producer didn't address. This is exactly the kind of finding the producer cannot see in their own work — they wrote both BRs and didn't notice the collision.
